package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"

	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"

)

const catalogHandlerTestTrackID = "9cdd012b-44ce-4f26-872e-1a0c214e2316"

type catalogHandlerTrackRepo struct {
	item domain.Track
}

func TestTrackGetIncludesGlobalOrder(t *testing.T) {
	order := 3
	handler := TrackHandler{GetUC: catalog.GetTrack{
		Tracks: catalogHandlerTrackRepo{item: domain.Track{
			ID: catalogHandlerTestTrackID, Slug: "backend", SourceKey: "catalog.track.backend", Order: &order, Status: domain.CatalogStatusActive,
		}},
		TrackI18n: catalogHandlerTrackI18nRepo{},
	}}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Get("/track/get/{trackID}", handler.Get)

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/track/get/"+catalogHandlerTestTrackID+"?fields=id,order", nil)
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(resp.Body.String(), `"order":3`) {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d; body=%s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
}

func (r catalogHandlerTrackRepo) Create(context.Context, domain.Track) error { return nil }
func (r catalogHandlerTrackRepo) Get(_ context.Context, id string) (*domain.Track, error) {
	if id != r.item.ID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	item := r.item
	return &item, nil
}
func (r catalogHandlerTrackRepo) GetBySourceKey(context.Context, string) (*domain.Track, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r catalogHandlerTrackRepo) Update(context.Context, domain.Track) error { return nil }
func (r catalogHandlerTrackRepo) Delete(context.Context, string) error       { return nil }
func (r catalogHandlerTrackRepo) List(context.Context, filters.TrackFilters) ([]domain.Track, error) {
	return []domain.Track{r.item}, nil
}

type catalogHandlerTrackI18nRepo struct{}

func (catalogHandlerTrackI18nRepo) Upsert(context.Context, domain.TrackI18n) error { return nil }
func (catalogHandlerTrackI18nRepo) ListByTrack(context.Context, string) ([]domain.TrackI18n, error) {
	return []domain.TrackI18n{{TrackID: catalogHandlerTestTrackID, I18nID: 1, Language: "ru", Title: "Трек", Description: "Описание"}}, nil
}
func (catalogHandlerTrackI18nRepo) Delete(context.Context, string, int) error { return nil }

func TestTrackGetPublicVisibility(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name       string
		status     int
		wantStatus int
	}{
		{name: "inactive track is hidden", status: domain.CatalogStatusNoActive, wantStatus: http.StatusNotFound},
		{name: "active track is visible", status: domain.CatalogStatusActive, wantStatus: http.StatusOK},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			handler := TrackHandler{GetUC: catalog.GetTrack{
				Tracks:    catalogHandlerTrackRepo{item: domain.Track{ID: catalogHandlerTestTrackID, Slug: "backend", SourceKey: "catalog.track.backend", Status: tt.status}},
				TrackI18n: catalogHandlerTrackI18nRepo{},
			}}
			router := chi.NewRouter()
			router.Get("/track/get/{trackID}", handler.Get)

			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/track/get/"+catalogHandlerTestTrackID, nil)
			resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

			if resp.Code != tt.wantStatus {
				t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d; body=%s", resp.Code, tt.wantStatus, resp.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

type catalogVisibilityCourseRepo struct {
	filter filters.CourseFilters
	sort   *filters.SortOptions
}

type catalogScopeRepo struct {
	lang   string
	scopes []domain.CatalogScope
}

func (r *catalogScopeRepo) ListPublic(_ context.Context, lang string) ([]domain.CatalogScope, error) {
	r.lang = lang
	return r.scopes, nil
}

func (*catalogVisibilityCourseRepo) Create(context.Context, domain.Course) error { return nil }
func (*catalogVisibilityCourseRepo) GetBySlug(context.Context, string) (*domain.Course, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (*catalogVisibilityCourseRepo) GetByID(context.Context, string) (*domain.Course, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (*catalogVisibilityCourseRepo) GetByIDWithFields(context.Context, string, queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (*catalogVisibilityCourseRepo) Update(context.Context, domain.Course) error { return nil }
func (*catalogVisibilityCourseRepo) Delete(context.Context, string) error        { return nil }
func (*catalogVisibilityCourseRepo) List(context.Context, string, filters.CourseFilters, *filters.SortOptions) ([]domain.CoursePreview, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (r *catalogVisibilityCourseRepo) ListFields(_ context.Context, _ string, _ queryfields.Set, filter filters.CourseFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	r.filter = filter
	r.sort = sort
	return nil, 0, nil
}

func TestCourseListAppliesCatalogVisibilityByRole(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name           string
		role           string
		wantActiveOnly bool
	}{
		{name: "anonymous public request", wantActiveOnly: true},
		{name: "student request", role: "STUDENT", wantActiveOnly: true},
		{name: "admin request", role: "ADMIN", wantActiveOnly: false},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			repo := &catalogVisibilityCourseRepo{}
			handler := CourseHandler{
				Validator: validator.New(),
				Logger:    zap.NewNop(),
				ListUC:    courseuc.ListCourses{Courses: repo},
			}
			router := chi.NewRouter()
			router.Use(middleware.AuthMiddleware)
			router.Get("/course/list", handler.List)

			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/course/list", nil)
			if tt.role != "" {
				req.Header.Set("X-User-ID", catalogHandlerTestTrackID)
				req.Header.Set("X-User-Role", tt.role)
			}
			resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

			if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
				t.Fatalf("status = %d; body=%s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
			}
			if repo.filter.CatalogActiveOnly != tt.wantActiveOnly {
				t.Fatalf("CatalogActiveOnly = %v, want %v", repo.filter.CatalogActiveOnly, tt.wantActiveOnly)
			}
			if tt.wantActiveOnly && (repo.filter.Status == nil || *repo.filter.Status != domain.CourseStatusActive) {
				t.Fatalf("public course status = %v, want active", repo.filter.Status)
			}
			if tt.wantActiveOnly && (repo.filter.CatalogVisible == nil || !*repo.filter.CatalogVisible) {
				t.Fatalf("public catalog visibility = %v, want true", repo.filter.CatalogVisible)
			}
			if !tt.wantActiveOnly && repo.filter.Status != nil {
				t.Fatalf("admin status was overridden: %v", *repo.filter.Status)
			}
			if !tt.wantActiveOnly && repo.filter.CatalogVisible != nil {
				t.Fatalf("admin catalog visibility was overridden: %v", *repo.filter.CatalogVisible)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCourseCatalogListForcesPublicVisibilityAndAuthoredOrder(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &catalogVisibilityCourseRepo{}
	handler := CourseHandler{
		Validator: validator.New(),
		Logger:    zap.NewNop(),
		ListUC:    courseuc.ListCourses{Courses: repo},
	}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Get("/catalog/course/list", handler.ListCatalog)

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/catalog/course/list?sort=title&order=desc", nil)
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d; body=%s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
	if repo.filter.Status == nil || *repo.filter.Status != domain.CourseStatusActive {
		t.Fatalf("catalog status = %v, want active", repo.filter.Status)
	}
	if repo.filter.CatalogVisible == nil || !*repo.filter.CatalogVisible {
		t.Fatalf("catalog visibility = %v, want true", repo.filter.CatalogVisible)
	}
	if !repo.filter.CatalogActiveOnly || !repo.filter.CatalogOrdered {
		t.Fatalf("catalog flags = active:%v ordered:%v, want true/true", repo.filter.CatalogActiveOnly, repo.filter.CatalogOrdered)
	}
	if repo.sort != nil {
		t.Fatalf("catalog sort = %#v, want authored hierarchy order", repo.sort)
	}
}

func TestCourseCatalogListUsesCompleteSlugPath(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &catalogVisibilityCourseRepo{}
	handler := CourseHandler{
		Validator: validator.New(),
		Logger:    zap.NewNop(),
		ListUC:    courseuc.ListCourses{Courses: repo},
	}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Get("/catalog/course/list", handler.ListCatalog)

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/catalog/course/list?track_slug=foundation&level_slug=beginner", nil)
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d; body=%s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
	if repo.filter.TrackSlug == nil || *repo.filter.TrackSlug != "foundation" {
		t.Fatalf("track slug = %#v", repo.filter.TrackSlug)
	}
	if repo.filter.LevelSlug == nil || *repo.filter.LevelSlug != "beginner" {
		t.Fatalf("level slug = %#v", repo.filter.LevelSlug)
	}
}

func TestCourseCatalogListRejectsPartialSlugPath(t *testing.T) {
	handler := CourseHandler{
		Validator: validator.New(),
		Logger:    zap.NewNop(),
		ListUC:    courseuc.ListCourses{Courses: &catalogVisibilityCourseRepo{}},
	}
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/catalog/course/list?level_slug=beginner", nil)
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ListCatalog(resp, req)

	if resp.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want 400; body=%s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestListCatalogScopesReturnsOnlyRepositoryScopes(t *testing.T) {
	order := 1
	repo := &catalogScopeRepo{scopes: []domain.CatalogScope{{
		TrackID: catalogHandlerTestTrackID, TrackSlug: "foundation", TrackTitle: "Фундамент разработчика", TrackOrder: &order,
		LevelID: "b0502515-792e-4dc0-99be-590e70fa4722", LevelSlug: "beginner", LevelTitle: "Начинающий", LevelOrder: 1, CourseCount: 6,
	}}}
	handler := CourseHandler{ScopeListUC: catalog.ListPublicScopes{Scopes: repo}}
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/catalog/scope/list", nil)
	req.Header.Set("Accept-Language", "ru-RU,ru;q=0.9")
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ListCatalogScopes(resp, req)

	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d; body=%s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
	if repo.lang != "ru" {
		t.Fatalf("lang = %q, want ru", repo.lang)
	}
	for _, fragment := range []string{`"track_slug":"foundation"`, `"level_slug":"beginner"`, `"course_count":6`} {
		if !strings.Contains(resp.Body.String(), fragment) {
			t.Fatalf("response does not contain %s: %s", fragment, resp.Body.String())
		}
	}
}
